e60082cc57f31b00.summary: Anatomy is an agent skill that creates interactive isometric illustrations of machines and complex systems, as polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
e60082cc57f31b00.unique: It is an open-source agent skill aimed at isometric SVG illustrations rather than a general image generator.
e60082cc57f31b00.benefit: People explaining a machine can ask an agent for a detailed isometric figure they can inspect.

861dedbb82b1e270.summary: MCPSafari is a native Safari MCP server so AI agents can work in the browser on a Mac.
861dedbb82b1e270.unique: It targets Safari specifically, including accessibility and browser automation for agents.
861dedbb82b1e270.benefit: Agent builders on macOS can drive Safari through MCP instead of a separate browser.

5fecc1e82f22ab7d.summary: HeyGen turns text, an image, or audio into a complete video with narration, captions, visuals, and animations.
5fecc1e82f22ab7d.unique: One input of text, image, or audio is enough for it to assemble the full video.
5fecc1e82f22ab7d.benefit: Creators can go from an idea to a narrated, captioned video without filming it themselves.

987cef64af4d2978.summary: Datology automatically curates model training data so teams can train faster, improve performance, and reduce costs.
987cef64af4d2978.unique: It focuses on enterprise-grade curation of the data used to train models.
987cef64af4d2978.benefit: Teams training their own models can spend less on data prep while aiming for better results.

611fa554fa71908e.summary: Underdog is a local AI for mail, calendar, and everyday work that runs on your computer.
611fa554fa71908e.unique: It stays on the computer you already use instead of sending that everyday work elsewhere.
611fa554fa71908e.benefit: People who want help with mail and calendar can run the assistant locally.

3b72fe2607b1d922.summary: Hermes Agent is a standalone terminal app and a native application for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
3b72fe2607b1d922.unique: You install it and keep talking with an agent that is meant to grow with you.
3b72fe2607b1d922.benefit: Developers can run a persistent agent in the terminal or in a native desktop app.

8fd9122373931141.summary: Agent Use Cases is a curated directory of real things people are doing with AI agents, scanned on an ongoing basis.
8fd9122373931141.unique: It collects working examples of what to build or delegate, not another agent runtime.
8fd9122373931141.benefit: Someone who already has an agent can browse concrete tasks to hand it.

bb77bee59da6ad5d.summary: awesome-jev-tools is a curated list of tools built for Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions.
bb77bee59da6ad5d.unique: The list is specific to Jev tools rather than general LLM libraries.
bb77bee59da6ad5d.benefit: Developers using Jev can find tools made for typed decisions in one list.

1af61c53a9a1026e.summary: AI System Design is a course on designing systems built on LLMs, RAG, and AI agents, taught step by step.
1af61c53a9a1026e.unique: The program walks through system design for those three pieces rather than a single model API.
1af61c53a9a1026e.benefit: Engineers learning to design LLM, RAG, and agent systems get a step-by-step path.

30a61943a75d7b7a.summary: awesome-decision-models lists decision models, including hosted APIs, open-weight models, runtimes, SDKs, applications, benchmarks, and papers.
30a61943a75d7b7a.unique: It covers System One and typed decision models across the stack, not only one vendor.
30a61943a75d7b7a.benefit: Builders comparing decision models can scan APIs, weights, runtimes, and papers in one list.

3aedabad940870b8.summary: awesome-jev-projects is a source-backed radar of the open-source Jev ecosystem, with plain-language project pages and automatic GitHub sync.
3aedabad940870b8.unique: It pairs ecosystem tracking with language meant for discovery, and it syncs from GitHub.
3aedabad940870b8.benefit: People exploring Jev projects can read short descriptions that stay tied to the source repos.

d2bc93caa6b4d6ba.summary: 3dviz-pro-max is an agent skill that turns an idea into a Three.js or Blender scene, with recipes, knowledge records, proved kits, and runnable studies.
d2bc93caa6b4d6ba.unique: It ships as a Claude Code and Codex plugin for creative 3D visualization.
d2bc93caa6b4d6ba.benefit: Developers using Claude Code or Codex can ask an agent to build an explorable 3D scene.

5ad34a0c5f9503ba.summary: Janus is an API router for AI models, written in Go, and it includes a Vulkan model runner.
5ad34a0c5f9503ba.unique: Routing and a Vulkan runner live in the same Go project.
5ad34a0c5f9503ba.benefit: Developers who want a Go router can also run models through its Vulkan runner.

7d39728bd8d56f58.summary: open-dot is a set of open-source personal AI agents that work on their own computers, with a Mac app using OpenAI and Composio.
7d39728bd8d56f58.unique: The agents are personal and run on their own computers, packaged as a Mac app.
7d39728bd8d56f58.benefit: Mac users can try open-source personal agents that act on their own machine.

43ce2405c958ffa7.summary: Autoloom is a free desktop client for AI coding that applies Aegis governance during execution, with baseline-aware changes and evidence-backed delivery.
43ce2405c958ffa7.unique: You pick the model, and governance is built into the run rather than added afterward.
43ce2405c958ffa7.benefit: Developers who want a coding agent can keep their model choice and get a record of what changed.

c9a6b6fcc33b2b9e.benefit: People already using Jev can try a workflow that puts it next to an LLM.

759a5e8a78b59960.benefit: Developers can look up Jev resources by decision pattern and see when the links were checked.

fc90db3c5a354c18.summary: awesome-typesafe-jev is a source-backed field guide to TypeSafe's System One model, with SDKs, live demos, agent tools, and independent evaluations.
fc90db3c5a354c18.unique: It collects demos and outside evaluations alongside the SDKs, not only official links.
fc90db3c5a354c18.benefit: Developers evaluating TypeSafe's System One model can start from SDKs, demos, and independent write-ups.

2d7da9943122530a.summary: awesome-jev from cobanov is a curated, source-backed list of projects built with Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions.
2d7da9943122530a.unique: Every listed project is tied back to a source and built around typed decisions.
2d7da9943122530a.benefit: Builders looking for real Jev projects can browse a list that cites its sources.

7c8ac8bb9f83abb6.summary: agents-universe is a shared-agent workspace where project members work together, and the agent writes experience from materials and work back into the project context.
7c8ac8bb9f83abb6.unique: It is presented as a digital stand-in that does work, not a question-answering bot.
7c8ac8bb9f83abb6.benefit: A project team can share one agent and the context it builds from their materials and work.

229eca4a8463a2cd.summary: explainroo makes explainer videos and product demos with an AI agent, using a local Kokoro voice, Whisper word timing, and a canvas renderer to turn a script into a narrated MP4.
229eca4a8463a2cd.unique: Voice, timing, and rendering stay local, and the project is free and open source.
229eca4a8463a2cd.benefit: An agent can turn a script into a narrated video without a paid voice or timing service.

08ea1ef3c56c7b20.summary: abide makes a coding agent follow all of a project's rules, with hooks, plugins, and skills for Claude Code and Codex.
08ea1ef3c56c7b20.unique: It is a rule-enforcement layer for those coding agents rather than another model.
08ea1ef3c56c7b20.benefit: Teams with written project rules can have Claude Code or Codex apply them during a run.

2c26ee007454d2a2.benefit: Creators can make a 2D avatar from one drawing with a coding agent and a local editor.

40771ea402156f90.summary: This free AI engineering course runs from machine learning, neural networks, and transformers through LLMs, fine-tuning, RAG, agents, inference, evaluation, safety, and system design.
40771ea402156f90.unique: It is a complete course path rather than a single library or model.
40771ea402156f90.benefit: Learners can follow one free sequence from core machine learning through agent systems and safety.

4bb3f4842d73670a.summary: rea reverse engineers anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

fb7ab59fa69f0381.unique: It is built to hold the lid closed safely, and only for a timed session.
fb7ab59fa69f0381.benefit: People running agents on a MacBook can close the lid for a set time without the machine sleeping.

22baff0fefab0b61.unique: Parametric CAD in pure Rust, with MCP automation as well as desktop and web.
22baff0fefab0b61.benefit: Designers and agents can build parametric 3D models in one Rust app, including through MCP.

e6251d499b27562d.summary: Agent37 gives every customer an agent in its own isolated sandbox, at up to 95% lower cost than most sandbox providers.
e6251d499b27562d.unique: Each customer gets an isolated sandbox, priced up to 95% below most sandbox providers.
e6251d499b27562d.benefit: Teams shipping agents can host one isolated sandbox per customer without typical sandbox prices.

e1b0220265d32580.benefit: Founders can have their own agent submit products to directories and keep the tracker locally.

b3449ae46e95172d.summary: Ambi is ambient intelligence that understands context in real time, remembers what matters, and helps move work forward across your devices.
b3449ae46e95172d.unique: It stays with context in real time and carries work across devices, rather than waiting for a fresh prompt each time.
b3449ae46e95172d.benefit: People who switch devices can keep context and follow-through in one ambient system.

e8726b993c2e2f5a.benefit: Teams watching new model architectures can follow a lab building both the models and the infrastructure.

b85ce8a761e51747.summary: Agentrail reconstructs real agent journeys across your website, docs, APIs, SDKs, and MCPs, including task completion rate and where agents break.
b85ce8a761e51747.unique: It stitches agent activity across docs, APIs, SDKs, and MCPs into the task the agent was trying to finish.
b85ce8a761e51747.benefit: Product teams can see where agents fail on their docs and APIs and what to fix first.

fd0702d2b5d0afbe.benefit: People who want to try Ambi can join the waitlist and apply for a free 7-day trial.

cb279fb80f5dd0da.unique: Review happens in the agent before push, using your login and no extra key.

c096ce42456c0a41.summary: agent-smith offers adaptive model routing, a glassy Codex usage monitor, and reproducible benchmarks with receipts.

c096ce42456c0a41.benefit: Developers watching Codex spend can route models and check usage with benchmarks that keep receipts.

7c9d184f8c058bd9.unique: A catalog of 180 video-making repos for coding agents, sorted by type and security grade.
7c9d184f8c058bd9.benefit: People who want agents to make video can pick a security-graded repo instead of searching from scratch.

c5e3b71711b5a7e6.unique: Each stage waits for your approval, and it runs locally with your own Claude Code or API key.
c5e3b71711b5a7e6.benefit: Motion designers can let Claude draft a video locally and still approve every stage.

c64663afb8f52236.summary: Atria-Dawn-Preview is an LLM agent project.

c64663afb8f52236.benefit: People looking for LLM agent code can start from a project that already has 589 stars.

246031679f85ee5d.unique: It ranks relay stations by measured availability, latency, and price, and can switch between them.
246031679f85ee5d.benefit: Claude Code and Codex users can compare AI API relays on uptime, latency, and price before switching.

5b736d3248424eb0.benefit: Developers can keep a coding agent on pi and AionUi while spending the big model only on harder steps.

00cf1a051a52ead0.unique: A from-scratch Rust model that is not a transformer, with self-modifying weights and CUDA training.
00cf1a051a52ead0.benefit: Researchers can study or train a Rust state-space language model that includes episodic memory.

7e7f1061b532e5f0.summary: ai-game-modding-guides collects guides for building game mods with AI coding agents, covering passthrough mods, Rust rewrites, mod loaders, prompting, and troubleshooting.
7e7f1061b532e5f0.unique: The guides focus on agent-built game mods, including Rust rewrites and mod loaders.
7e7f1061b532e5f0.benefit: Modders can follow agent-oriented steps for passthrough mods, Rust rewrites, and loader setup.

2b61eb1abccd218a.summary: solvecraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Autodesk Fusion 360 in pure Rust, with parametric 3D CAD for desktop, browser, and AI agents via MCP.
2b61eb1abccd218a.unique: A clean-room Fusion 360-style CAD app in pure Rust that agents can drive through MCP.
2b61eb1abccd218a.benefit: Designers and agents can do parametric CAD in the browser or on the desktop without the original product.

8a441a7266e1bc3f.summary: awesome-jev-use-cases lists TypeSafe AI Jev use cases: 74 demos ranked by likes, 150+ GitHub repos, plus limits, cost, and API examples. It is CC0.
8a441a7266e1bc3f.unique: A CC0 catalog of 74 liked demos and 150+ repos, with cost and API examples.
8a441a7266e1bc3f.benefit: Developers evaluating Jev can browse ranked demos, repos, limits, and API examples in one list.

b8f7576006e38611.unique: Memory is a git repo with MEMORY.md, sourced one-line entries, and links between files. Dreaming lets Devin self-improve that memory across sessions.
